meta.title: Trucker: road freight across the Gulf
meta.description: Trucker is a planned road freight platform for shippers, carriers, vehicle owners and drivers, in English, Arabic and Urdu.

environment.development: Development build. Not a live service. All content is sample content.

hero.title: Road freight across the Gulf, one signed step at a time
hero.lead: Shipper, carrier and driver work from the same record, from pick-up to proof of delivery. In English, Arabic and Urdu.

example.title: Dubai to Riyadh
example.label: Illustration
example.note: The shipper, the carrier and operations read this same list. Each step shows who signed it and when.

items.title: Post the load
items.text: Describe the goods, the sites and the time windows once.

items.title: Compare offers and book
items.text: Verified carriers quote. You accept one, with the price and terms fixed.

items.title: Follow each signed step
items.text: The driver signs every milestone, even without signal.

items.title: Confirm proof of delivery
items.text: Photos and the receiver's signature close the job.

items.title: Shippers
items.text: Describe a load once, compare offers on the same terms and follow every step to delivery.

items.title: Carriers
items.text: See loads that fit your fleet and the routes you are permitted to run. Assign truck, trailer and driver.

items.title: Drivers and vehicle owners
items.text: One clear next step at every stop. Steps are saved on the phone when there is no signal.

languages.title: The same sign in three languages
languages.lead: Every screen is designed in English, Arabic and Urdu. Arabic and Urdu read right to left; numbers, plates and references stay left to right.

footer.note: Draft copy. The service described is planned, not live. Launch countries and routes are not decided.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.text: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

signIn.title: Sign in or register
signIn.lead: Enter your mobile number. We send a one-time code to it. If the number is new, you continue to registration.
signIn.phoneHint: Start with + and the country code, for example +971 5X XXX XXXX.
signIn.phoneNote: Any country's number can be used. The country of the number does not decide what your company may do.

code.title: Enter the code
code.codeHint: 6 digits. The code works once and for a few minutes only.
code.resendNote: A new code replaces the old one.
code.developmentText: No text message is sent in this build. The code is {code}.

register.title: Finish registration
register.lead: Tell us your name. Your mobile number is already confirmed.
register.nameHint: As you want other people on Trucker to see it.
register.emailHint: For contact only. It is not used to sign in or to recover your account.

account.title: Your account
account.name: Name
account.sessionsLead: Each sign-in is a session. End any session you do not recognise.

errors.phone: Enter the mobile number with + and the country code.
errors.code_format: Enter the 6 digits of the code.
errors.code_expired: That code has expired. Send a new code.
errors.code_replaced: A newer code was sent. Use the newest code.
errors.code_locked: Too many incorrect attempts. Send a new code.
errors.code_already_used: That code has already been used. Send a new code.
errors.code_resend_too_soon: A code was sent a moment ago. Wait {seconds} seconds, then try again.
errors.too_many_code_requests: Too many codes were requested for this number. Try again later.
errors.code_delivery_unavailable: Codes cannot be sent in this environment.
errors.registration_closed: Registration is not open in this environment.
errors.terms_version_changed: The notice has changed. Read the current text and try again.
errors.session_ended: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.email: Enter a complete e-mail address, or leave the field empty.
errors.terms: Tick the box to confirm that you have read the notice.
errors.unavailable: The service did not answer. Nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.no_challenge: Start again: enter your mobile number.
